title: DevX Ramp Cohorts: Guided SDK & Quickstart Initiative
creator: Aisha K. Patel
description: Initiative to create a tracked, cohort-based ramp program for new developer signups focused on first-week success with Redwood SDKs, docs, and quickstarts. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-successful-call by 40% for cohort participants, increase 14-day retention for new SDK users by 25%, and create reproducible playbooks for Solutions and Developer Advocates to run cohorts. This ticket coordinates roadmap planning, OKR mapping, content production, instrumented analytics, and a pilot cohort in Q4. Scope: JS + Python SDK quickstarts, a condensed docs path (2–3 pages), 3 guided quickstarts, and a cohort facilitator playbook. Out of scope for MVP: localization, enterprise-only onboarding flows, full CLI walkthroughs.
acceptance_criteria: Three guided quickstarts (JS web, Python server, embeddings sample) published and linked from the Developer Getting Started page
Cohort facilitator playbook (Confluence) with schedule, checklist, and escalation paths completed
Instrumentation live in Amplitude and Console onboarding funnel dashboard with event names and owner mapping
Pilot cohort (n=25) executed with pre/post survey and retention signal captured
Two SDK bugfixes identified during pilot triaged and assigned to ENG owners
comments: 2025-09-03 - Kickoff: Alignment with Solutions and DevRel. Decided narrow scope for MVP (JS + Python). Action: content owners assigned (Liam, Priya). Links: https://confluence.redwood.ai/devx/ramp-cohorts-kickoff

2025-09-10 - Design review (DES-412): UX recommended inline code sandboxes rather than full local installs for first week to reduce friction. Trade-off: less coverage of local debugging but much faster TTFSC (time to first successful call). Awaiting final sign-off.

2025-09-18 - Engineering sync: ENG-8533 to add onboarding telemetry hooks (events: signup_cohort_opt_in, quickstart_started, quickstart_completed, first_api_call). ETA: 2025-09-30. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1478
2025-09-29 - Content freeze for MVP demos. Quickstarts drafted and handed to Tech Writing for edits. Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/devx/guided-pathways/drafts

2025-10-02 - Product review: opt-in cohort model chosen (email + in-app banner) rather than mandatory guided flow, to minimize interference with self-serve funnel. PM note: this will require subtle analytics to attribute impact to cohorts vs self-serve.

2025-10-06 - Pilot recruitment plan approved: internal beta + partner customers + public signup form. Stake owners: DevRel (recruitment), Growth (email template). Google Form: https://forms.gle/rw-cohort-pilot
2025-10-09 - Pre-pilot checklist passing. Scheduler and calendar invites templated. Questions: finalize success survey and NPS framing (assigned to Priya).

signals_and_metrics: Primary KPI: time-to-first-successful-call (target: -40% for cohort participants vs baseline)
Retention: 14-day active usage for cohort participants (target +25% vs control)
Activation funnel conversion (sign-up -> opt-in -> quickstart started -> quickstart completed)
Survey NPS and qualitative friction notes from pilot participants
Operational: average cohort facilitation time per participant and 1st-week support tickets (target <0.2 tickets/user)
